message: cens()/trunc() need a family with a CDF (currently: gaussian, lognormal, poisson, exponential, weibull, inverse.gaussian, cox). The list is not closed: a family supplies one through the lcdf argument of frmtmb_family(), and a family that only ever sees RIGHT censoring may supply the log survivor fun
